sinopsis.es: Con Michelle Yeoh, ganadora del Oscar por Everything Everywhere All at Once, esta comedia inspirada sobre una mujer camino de dominar el cubo mágico es un relato de picardía competitiva y rebeldía sin edad.
sinopsis.en: Led by Oscar winner Michelle Yeoh (Everything Everywhere All at Once), this inspired comedy about a woman on the road to magic-cube mastery is a story of galvanizing gamesmanship and ageless defiance.
